title: Among schools located in the five counties with the lowest total K–12 enrol
question: Among schools located in the five counties with the lowest total K–12 enrollment, identify those where the SAT excellence rate exceeds 0.25. For each such school, return its name, the administrator’s full name (first and last), the type of education offered, and the eligible free meal rate for students aged 5–17.

prediction.sql:
WITH county_enrollment AS (
  SELECT s."XCL_045" AS county, SUM(f."XCL_019") AS total_enrollment
  FROM frpm f
  INNER JOIN schools s ON f."XCL_001" = s."XCL_041"
  GROUP BY s."XCL_045"
),
top5 AS (
  SELECT county FROM county_enrollment ORDER BY total_enrollment ASC LIMIT 5
)
SELECT s."XCL_047" AS school_name,
       s."XCL_080" AS admin_first_name,
       s."XCL_081" AS admin_last_name,
       s."XCL_069" AS education_type,
       f."XCL_026" AS free_meal_rate_5_17
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN frpm f ON s."XCL_041" = f."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN satscores sat ON s."XCL_041" = sat."XCL_030"
WHERE s."XCL_045" IN (SELECT county FROM top5)
  AND CAST(sat."XCL_040" AS REAL) / sat."XCL_036" > 0.25

eligibility_lowering.pre_lowering_sql:
WITH county_enrollment AS (
  SELECT s."XCL_045" AS county, SUM(f."XCL_019") AS total_enrollment
  FROM frpm f
  INNER JOIN schools s ON f."XCL_001" = s."XCL_041"
  GROUP BY s."XCL_045"
),
top5 AS (
  SELECT county FROM county_enrollment ORDER BY total_enrollment ASC LIMIT 5
)
SELECT s."XCL_047" AS school_name,
       s."XCL_080" AS admin_first_name,
       s."XCL_081" AS admin_last_name,
       s."XCL_069" AS education_type,
       f."XCL_026" AS free_meal_rate_5_17
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN frpm f ON s."XCL_041" = f."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN satscores sat ON s."XCL_041" = sat."XCL_030"
WHERE s."XCL_045" IN (SELECT county FROM top5)
  AND CAST(sat."XCL_040" AS REAL) / sat."XCL_036" > 0.25
